mainHeaderSection.subtitle: Our Module
mainHeaderSection.description: Tech Cloud ERP’s Inventory Management System lets you control your stock with accuracy and efficiency  from raw materials to finished goods. It offers real-time inventory tracking, automated stock updates, and smart alerts to avoid shortages or overstocking. With better visibility and control, you save costs, improve order fulfillment and keep operations running smoothly.

featureSections.featuredesc: Start your production process with a Planned Order based on demand forecasts or actual sales orders. Tech Cloud ERP converts these into actionable plans, helping you schedule resources and estimate material needs in advance. From there, create a detailed production order by defining the bill of materials (BOM), routing and operations. Once released, tasks are distributed to work centres for smooth executions

Monitor every phase of the production process with operation-level execution. As your products move through various stages like cutting, assembling or testing, the system records machine usage, labor hours and progress. This improves transparency and helps maintain high product quality while reducing wastage.

Easily issue raw materials or semi-finished goods to the shop floor using Goods Issue to Production. Every issue is logged against the respective production order to ensure material accuracy and full traceability supporting better inventory control and audit readiness.

faqs.subTitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.title: Everything You Need to Know About Our CRM Solution

items.question: What is production management software?
items.answer: Production management software helps manufacturers plan, execute and track production processes, improving efficiency, quality and traceability across the shop floor.

items.question: Can I create and customize production orders?
items.answer: Yes. Tech Cloud ERP allows full customisation of production orders, including operations, routing steps and bill of materials.

items.question: How does production planning software help?
items.answer: It helps forecast demand accurately, allocate resources efficiently and schedule tasks effectively. This minimizes downtime, improves workflow, and ensures products are delivered on time.

items.question: Is the system suitable for different types of manufacturing?
items.answer: Absolutely. Tech Cloud ERP supports both make-to-stock and make-to-order manufacturing environments, making it flexible for a wide range of industries.
